# Test PGO stack size optimizations in Tango

# this test rebuild runtime with different flags, skip in short mode
[short] skip

# generate cpu.prof with high runtime.copystack usage
go run test_copystack.go
# check the initial stack size is the default value 2048 in go runtime
stdout 'initial stack size is 2048'

# build with default PGO, assert the initial stack size is still 2048
go build -pgo ./cpu.prof -gcflags=all='-d=pgodebug=1,pgostacksize=0' -o copystack test_copystack.go
# check the stackMin constant is not rewritten by compile
! stderr 'pgo stack size optimization rewrites stackMin to 32768 from profile'
exec ./copystack
# check the initial stack size is still 2048
stdout 'the initial stack size is 2048'

# build with PGO's stack size optimization, adjust initial stack size from profile
go build -pgo ./cpu.prof -gcflags=all='-d=pgodebug=1,pgostacksize=1' -o copystack test_copystack.go
# check the stackMin constant is rewritten by compile
stderr 'pgo stack size optimization rewrites stackMin to 32768 from profile'
exec ./copystack
# check the initial stack size is changed to 32768 by PGO
stdout 'the initial stack size is 32768'

# build with PGO's stack size optimization again, continue to use the optimized stack size from profile
go build -pgo ./cpu.prof -gcflags=all='-d=pgodebug=1,pgostacksize=1' -o copystack test_copystack.go
# check the stackMin constant is rewritten by compile
stderr 'pgo stack size optimization rewrites stackMin to 32768 from profile'
exec ./copystack
# check the initial stack size is still 32768
stdout 'the initial stack size is 32768'


-- prof --
-- test_copystack.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"os"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"sync"
	"time"
	_ "unsafe"
)

func GrowStack(v int) int {
	if v == 0 {
		return v
	}
	data := [64]int{12}

	return GrowStack(v-1) + data[0]
}

func Workers() {
	wg := sync.WaitGroup{}
	n := 1000000
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			GrowStack(16)
			wg.Done()
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
}

//go:linkname stackMin runtime.getStackMin
func stackMin() int

func main() {
	runWithProfiling("cpu.prof", Workers)
	fmt.Printf("the initial stack size is %d\n", stackMin())
}

type tangoInfoWriter struct {
	io.Writer
}

func (w tangoInfoWriter) NeedTangoInfo() bool {
	return true
}

func runWithProfiling(filename string, fn func()) time.Duration {
	f, err := os.Create(filename)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("fail to create CPU profile: ", err)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	if err := pprof.StartCPUProfile(tangoInfoWriter{f}); err != nil {
		log.Fatal("fail to start CPU profile: ", err)
	}
	defer pprof.StopCPUProfile()
	t := time.Now()
	fn()
	d := time.Now().Sub(t)
	return d
}
